note: Adapted from Maiti & Chakraborty's paper on the termite fauna of the Andaman—Nicobar Islands, original in English; the type material comes from soil covering on a tree trunk in the Haddo Zoo, Port Blair, South Andaman, collected by B. Nandi and S. K. Chakraborty. The original explicitly records the alate as unknown; the soldier measurements table is printed in two columns, 'holotype / range of 10 individuals', and has been translated accordingly. The pronotum description at the end of the worker section is cut off outside the scan window and has not been translated.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head (excluding the nasus) nearly circular, almost as long as wide, posterior margin rounded; nasus conical, thick, far longer than half the head capsule; pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, twice as wide as long and about half the head-capsule width, anterior lobe strongly raised, anterior margin with a fringe of fine hairs and without a median notch; antennae 12—13-segmented; tibial spur formula 2:2:2; cerci 2-segmented, without styli. Alate unknown.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head pale brown to dark brown, the base of the nasus and the posterior part of the head paler; antennae pale brown; pronotum yellowish brown, the anterior lobe darker; legs yellowish white; pronotum with a few fine hairs; abdominal tergites with a few fine hairs; sternites and legs densely hairy. Total length (with the nasus, without the antennae) 3.53—3.62 mm. Head (without the nasus) nearly circular, almost as long as wide, posterior margin rounded; in lateral view the posterior swelling of the head rather strongly developed, the dorsal margin nearly straight and bearing a nasal hump. Nasus conical and thick, far longer than half the head length, with a pair of erect hairs at the apex and another pair at the base of the nasus. Fontanelle gland and fontanelle duct distinct. Antennae 12—13-segmented; in the 13-segmented form segment 2 slightly shorter than segment 3, segment 3 twice as long as segment 4, segment 4 the shortest, the segments lengthening from the 5th onward; in the 12-segmented form segments 5 and 2 the shortest. Mandibles reduced, each with a short spine-like apical process situated near the middle of its length; the margin between the process and the molar plate almost straight; molar area slightly deep, weakly convex. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, twice as wide as long and nearly half the head-capsule width; anterior lobe strongly raised, anterior margin rounded, with a fringe of fine hairs, without a median notch; lateral margins weakly curved outward and diverging anteriorly; posterior margin rounded, without a distinct emargination. Legs short, tibial spur formula 2:2:2. Abdomen elongate-oval, cerci 2-segmented, without styli. Measurements (holotype / range of 10 individuals): head including nasus 1.52/1.45—1.52 mm, head excluding nasus 0.93/0.90—0.93 mm, nasus length 0.59/0.55—0.59 mm, maximum nasus width 0.25/0.24—0.25 mm, maximum head width 0.91/0.86—0.92 mm, maximum head height 0.63/0.57—0.63 mm, head index (width/head length without the nasus) 0.98/0.95—0.99, nasal index (nasus length/head length without the nasus) 0.63/0.61—0.63, maximum pronotum length 0.19/0.14—0.23 mm, maximum pronotum width 0.45/0.45—0.46 mm, pronotum-head index (pronotum width/head width) 0.49/0.49—0.52, number of antennal segments 12/12—13.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule yellowish brown; antennae, labrum, pronotum and legs yellowish white; head and pronotum sparsely hairy, abdomen more densely hairy. Total length (excluding antennae) 3.30—3.50 mm. Head nearly square, slightly wider than long; lateral margins weakly divergent anteriorly; posterior margin nearly rounded; Y suture distinct. Fontanelle plate white, translucent, situated near the middle. Antennae 12—13-segmented; in the 13-segmented form segments 2 and 4 subequal in length and segment 3 the smallest, in the 12-segmented form segment 2 the shortest. Postclypeus strongly raised, hairy, divided into two equal halves by an indistinct median line. Anteclypeus trapezoidal, white, hairless. Labrum slightly wider than long, with a few hairs on its body surface. Mandibles of the Nasutitermes type: left mandible with 1 apical tooth and 2 marginal teeth, the apical tooth conical, the first marginal tooth pointed and longer than the second, the second marginal tooth situated far below the first; right mandible also with 1 apical tooth and 2 marginal teeth, the apical tooth larger than the first marginal tooth, the first marginal tooth conical and larger than the second, the second marginal tooth with a longer posterior margin; molar region rather long and with distinct serrations. The pronotum description is cut off in the original scan window.
